title: 「Not until then + 倒裝句」表達「直到那時才……」
titleZh: 「Not until then + 倒裝句」表達「直到那時才……」

source.file: Sentence Structure 225 -「Not until then + 倒裝句」表達「直到那時才……」.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered 225; it is assigned system ID ss226 because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: Previous event + but not until then + auxiliary + subject + main verb

formulas.formula: Previous event + but not until then did + subject + base verb
Previous event + but not until then was / were + subject + complement
Previous event + but not until then could + subject + base verb

example: I had heard the story before, but not until then did I understand its meaning.
exampleZh: 我之前聽過這個故事，但直到那時我才明白它的意義。

examples.en: I had heard the story before, but not until then did I understand its meaning.
examples.zh: 我之前聽過這個故事，但直到那時我才明白它的意義。
examples.highlight: I had heard the story before, but not until then did I understand its meaning.

meaning.zh: 這個句型表示某件事情在特定時刻之前一直沒有發生，直到前述事件發生後，情況才改變。

rules.zh: 後面要使用倒裝語序 普通語序： I understood the rule. 倒裝語序： Not until then did I understand the rule. 助動詞 did 要放在主語 I 前面。
rules.en: Use inversion after not until then by placing the auxiliary before the subject: “Not until then did I understand the rule.”

rules.zh: 一般過去式要使用 did + 主語 + 原形動詞 正確： Not until then did I understand the rule. 錯誤： Not until then I understood the rule. 錯誤： Not until then did I understood the rule. did 已經表示過去時間，因此後面的動詞必須使用原形： did I understand 不是： did I understood
rules.en: For the past simple, use did + subject + base verb. Because did already marks past time, write did I understand, not did I understood.

rules.zh: 使用 be 時，不需要加入 did 普通語序： Sara was calm. 倒裝語序： Not until then was Sara calm. 普通語序： The rooms were ready. 倒裝語序： Not until then were the rooms ready.
rules.en: With the verb be, invert was or were directly and do not add did: “Not until then was Sara calm.”

rules.zh: 使用 could 等情態動詞時，把情態動詞放在主語前面 普通語序： We could see the town. 倒裝語序： Not until then could we see the town. could 後面的動詞使用原形： could we see
rules.en: With a modal such as could, place the modal before the subject and use the base verb after it.

rules.zh: 必須清楚指向前面的一件事情或一個時刻 清楚： The teacher explained the rule again, but not until then did I understand it. then 指的是「老師再次解釋規則的時候」。 不清楚： Not until then did I understand it. 如果前文沒有說明發生了甚麼，讀者便不知道 then 指哪個時刻。
rules.en: Then must refer clearly to an event or moment mentioned earlier; without that context, the reader cannot know which time then means.

rules.zh: 只有 Not until then 後面的子句需要倒裝 正確： The rain stopped, but not until then did we leave the house. 第一部分： The rain stopped. 使用普通語序。 第二部分： not until then did we leave 使用倒裝語序。
rules.en: Invert only the clause after not until then. The preceding event remains in normal word order.

rules.zh: 這個句型通常描述真正的時間轉變 它不只是把兩件無關的事情放在一起。 自然： The lights came back on, but not until then could I see the number. 燈亮起後，「看見號碼」才變得可能。 不自然： The lights came back on, but not until then did Ben buy some bread. 兩件事情之間沒有清楚的時間或意義關係。
rules.en: Use the structure for a genuine turning point in time, not to connect two unrelated events.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能清楚指出情況在哪一刻出現改變。 The doctor explained the results, but not until then was Sara calm. 讀者會明白，莎拉在醫生解釋結果之前一直未能平靜下來。
benefits.en: It clearly shows a turning point and tells the reader exactly when a situation changed.

benefits.zh: 第二句把 Not until then 放在較重要的位置，因此更能強調「在此之前一直不明白」。
benefits.en: It gives important information more emphasis by foregrounding the fact that something had not happened before that moment.

benefits.zh: 第一部分說明先發生的事情，第二部分說明其後才出現的結果，讓讀者更容易掌握事情的先後次 序。
benefits.en: It makes the order of events easier to follow: the first part gives the earlier event, and the second gives what changed afterwards.

benefits.zh: 你可以用這個句型描述發現真相、突然明白、情緒轉變、問題變得清楚，或某件事情終於變得可 行。
benefits.en: It is useful in stories for discoveries, sudden understanding, changes in feeling, newly clear problems and actions that finally become possible.

benefits.zh: 這個句型提供另一種組織句子的方法，避免不斷重複使用相同的 until 句式。
benefits.en: It gives you another way to organise a sentence instead of repeatedly using an ordinary did not ... until ... pattern.

benefits.zh: 這個句型適合用於反思文章，說明某段經歷如何令你產生新的理解。 I had seen the problem many times, but not until then did I understand its cause. （我以前曾多次看見這個問題，但直到那時我才明白它的成因。）
benefits.en: It can make reflective writing more effective when explaining how an experience changed your understanding.
